option_relations.rationale: Cutaneous metastatic breast carcinoma is a broader term that encompasses telangiectatic metastatic breast carcinoma
Carcinoma erysipeloides is a type of cutaneous metastasis from breast carcinoma, which can manifest as telangiectatic metastatic breast carcinoma
Telangiectatic metastatic breast carcinoma (TMBC) is the exact term used to describe the condition in the leaf
Carcinoma en cuirasse is a different variant of breast carcinoma metastasis and does not match the description of telangiectatic metastatic breast carcinoma
